title: M-PIPE — the video pipeline: 13 stages, and published means verified
desc:
DELIVERABLE: world/channels/<key>.json + world/videos/<vid>.json + world.py video subcommands per docs/WORLD.md. The 13 stages as an explicit state machine: every transition needs --evidence; stage 9 (publish-approved) requires the recorded approver and the CLI REFUSES any approver but the authorized one (Director-gated, CHARTER section 5 — until the contract records a delegation); stage 12 (verified) requires a live url + verified_ts; stage 13 deposits the receipt to storagecode. Illegal transitions refused (e.g. 8 -> 11). The last two stages run on the STUB executor — a receipt-writing stand-in, clearly labeled 'stub' in the record AND on the map — until the bridge lands.
EVIDENCE: a dummy video walked through all 13 stages (paste); the refused illegal transition; the refused wrong-name approval; the stub receipt.
OWNS: world/channels/, world/videos/, tools/world.py (video module), tests/test_pipeline.py.
NOTE: motion-studio already renders real MP4s (M2 sits in the review queue) — do NOT rebuild rendering; the pipeline records what exists.
